q: As per the Railway Servants (Hours of Work and Period of Rest) Rules, 2005, (A) If the period of duty is seven hours in the case of 'intensive' workers it amounts to long-on (B) If the period of duty is nine hours in the case of 'continuous' workers it amounts to long-on

options.D: Both A & B are correct

e: The correct answer is Both A & B are incorrect. Both statements are wrong, so option C is the answer. Under the 2005 Rules, ‘long on’ means a period of duty over 8 hours for intensive workers, over 10 hours for continuous workers and over 12 hours for essentially intermittent workers.
